title: Mixed Event — We Escape to Survive — Episode8 In Spite Of Fear

meta.Event Outline: With Mafuyu's contact with the group restricted, the rest of N25 think what they can do for her. Hoping to give her some peace of mind, Mizuki comes up with a plan...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sure it's hard to get your head around right now since you might not be ready yet.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I just want you to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When you find yourself backed into a corner, you still have the option to run.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, your cram school's supposed to end soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I guess we have to say bye here.
Get home safe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting me today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was nice to see you again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Even after you get home, you probably won't be able to take your mind off things...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But we'll always be on your side.
So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: All of us in N25... We'll always be waiting for you in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Mizuki...
What's going on? You asked us to meet sort of out of the blue.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did you come up with a good idea for Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Sorry, I know this is really sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's something I need to tell you two...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just saw Mafuyu and let her know that it's okay for her to run.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You told Mafuyu about all that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And I'm really sorry about going to talk to her without asking you guys first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I felt that I needed to tell her.
Before her spirit breaks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, because I went ahead and did what I did, I thought I should tell you two what happened...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's okay for her to run...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree that Mafuyu should keep that option in mind considering her current state.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. As much as I want her to directly fight back, I guess she should have some contingencies ready if she doesn't think she can...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If Mafuyu does decide to run, she'll always be welcome to stay at my house...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same here. She won't be able to stay forever, but I'll try asking my mom about this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's no way of telling what's gonna happen to Mafuyu moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I wanna do everything I can.
For her sake...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Looks like they know what to do now.
What is it with you and sneaking around like this...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? That sounds a bit odd considering how you're sitting next to me right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were also curious about what they were doing here, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's better than standing around and doing nothing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I want her to have as many options as possible right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how their solution is going to affect Mafuyu moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was worried that Mafuyu's situation had gotten so bad that we wouldn't be able to do anything to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I got a chance to tell her how I feel. I managed to say, “It's okay to run.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But how she proceeds is up to her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, if she does choose to run, that's gonna be on me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm honestly a little scared about her doing that, but I also wanna do everything I can to help her...)
